statement: generateIdentity, seed to mnemonic and back via identityFromMnemonic reproduces the same seed, keypair and uid.
uid is SHA-256 of the box public key, first 16 bytes, as 32-char lowercase hex, and equals uidForBoxPublicKey.
An invalid BIP39 mnemonic makes identityFromMnemonic throw ArgumentError.
The uid for the known box public key matches the pinned known-answer vector.
deriveBackupKey is deterministic for the same seed and domain.
deriveBackupKey yields different keys for different domains.
deriveBackupKey matches the known-answer vectors, including the pad-to-16 and no-padding branches.
deriveSigningKeyPair is deterministic for the same seed and domain.
deriveSigningKeyPair public key matches the known-answer vector.
deriveStoreBindingToken matches the known-answer vector.
deriveStoreBindingToken is a valid 8-4-4-4-12 UUID and differs from the uid.
deriveStoreBindingToken yields different tokens for different domains.
The known-answer vectors in SPEC.md are re-derived independently from hashlib and cryptography.
encryptBlob/decryptBlob round-trip a JSON map with a symmetric key.
decryptBlob with the wrong key fails authentication.
encryptBlobWithBox/decryptBlobWithBox round-trip between two identities and both directions agree on the shared secret.
encryptBlobWithBoxDisposing disposes the box after success.
decryptBlobWithBoxDisposing disposes the box after success.
decryptBlobWithBoxDisposing disposes the box even when decryption throws.
sealString/openSealedString round-trip a string through an anonymous sealed box.
openSealedString with the wrong key returns null rather than throwing.
openSealedBytes round-trips raw bytes.
signDetached/verifyDetached round-trip, and a tampered payload fails verification.
canonicalJsonBytes sorts map keys recursively and emits whitespace-free JSON.
verifyDetached returns false rather than throwing on malformed input.
deriveSharedSecret produces an X25519 precalculated box from a peer public key and own secret key.
IdentityConfig carries five per-app namespace fields: seedStorageKey, backupKeyDomain, signingKeyDomain, storeBindingDomain, blockStoreChannel.
box_decrypt golden vectors decrypt via deriveSharedSecret and decryptBlobWithBox.
secretbox_decrypt golden vectors decrypt via decryptBlob, and expectFail cases throw SodiumException.
seal_open golden vectors open via openSealedString, and tampered or wrong-recipient cases return null.
Swift mirror reproduces the box_decrypt, secretbox_decrypt and seal_open golden vectors from test/crypto_vectors.json.
Kotlin mirror reproduces the box_decrypt, secretbox_decrypt and seal_open golden vectors from test/crypto_vectors.json.
Native deriveSharedKey returns nil for a wrong-length key and is symmetric between the two parties.
Native box and secretbox encrypt output is base64 of nonce followed by ciphertext, and round-trips.
Native box and secretbox decrypt return nil, never throw, for garbage, truncated or wrong-key input.
Kotlin decryptBoxBytes returns the same plaintext bytes as decryptBox, without the JSON parse.
Kotlin decryptBoxBytes returns null for a wrong key, truncated payload or invalid base64.
A failed read is never reported as no identity (enforced by the consuming storage layer, not this package).
A fresh seed never overwrites an existing one without explicit recovery intent (enforced by the consuming storage layer).
